vendors.name: JFrog Xray
vendors.offering: Impact graph and impact search linking vulnerable components to affected artifacts, builds, deployments
vendors.pricing: Enterprise X from $950/month; JFrog Advanced Security sold in optional Unified/Ultimate Security bundles (Enterprise X / Enterprise+ only), bundle price not public

vendors.name: Semgrep Supply Chain
vendors.offering: SCA with dependency paths, CycloneDX graph export, direct-dependency attribution for transitive vulns
vendors.pricing: Free up to 10 contributors; Team $30 per contributor/month (some Semgrep pages show $40); Enterprise custom

vendors.name: Endor Labs
vendors.offering: Reachability SCA with dependency graph and call paths through transitive dependencies

vendors.name: GitLab Ultimate dependency list
vendors.offering: Dependency list with dependency paths for vulnerable transitive packages, SBOM-based scanning
vendors.pricing: Ultimate tier only; price not public

vendors.name: GitHub Dependabot / Code Security
vendors.offering: Dependabot alerts label transitive dependencies and show the path to the direct dependency
vendors.pricing: Dependabot alerts included with GitHub; Code Security $30 per active committer/month

vendors.name: Dependency Track SaaS (YourSky.blue)
vendors.offering: Hosted OWASP Dependency-Track: SBOM portfolio, parent/child project hierarchy, vulnerability tracking
vendors.pricing: AWS Marketplace: Standard $250/month (10 users, 20 projects); High Availability $500/month

vendors.name: Datadog Code Security (SCA)
vendors.offering: SCA showing 'Introduced by' root library for vulnerable transitive packages
vendors.pricing: Software Composition Analysis $10-15 per host/month on price list; committer-based Code Security price not found

paid_market_gaps.gap: GitLab shows only one shortest path, only for vulnerable dependencies and a limited set of package managers
GitHub's transitive path labels cover only npm and Maven and need dependency-graph submission enabled
Dependency-Track users lack the parent/root dependency of a vulnerable component in finding views
Linking SBOM components to deployed applications and containers for impact analysis stays largely manual

wtp_evidence: Buyers pay for SCA suites that include dependency paths and impact search (Semgrep Team $30/contributor/month, GitHub Code Security $30/committer/month, JFrog Enterprise X from $950/month with Advanced Security as a paid add-on bundle), but the capability is sold as a feature, not standalone.
bundling_note: GitHub Dependabot alerts show transitive paths at no extra cost and GitLab Ultimate, JFrog and Semgrep include dependency paths and impact search in existing SCA plans.
summary: No standalone opening: dependency paths and impact search are standard SCA features, bundled by GitHub and GitLab. Narrow wedge: reverse-impact across heterogeneous third-party/container SBOMs for Dependency-Track users, likely an add-on, not a company.
